entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wooden hunting lodge was set right in the heart of the forest.
entries.zh: 木制狩猎小屋就在森林的心脏

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She lived in an old, terraced cottage at the end of a narrow dirt track.
entries.zh: 她住在一个老式的露台小屋里, 在一个狭窄的土轨的尽头。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The farmhouse was over four hundred years old. It was made out of great stone slabs and had a red tiled roof.
entries.zh: 农舍有四百多年的历史,用大石板砌成,有红瓦屋顶.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She lived in a street of terraced Victorian houses, each with a bay window at the side of the front door.
entries.zh: 她住在一条露台式的维多利亚式房屋的街道上,每栋房屋前门的一侧都有一个海湾窗.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The red-brick manor house was set in ten acres of woodland. It was a tall, imposing house and its numerous towers made it look like a fortress.
entries.zh: 红砖庄园的房屋布置在十亩林地中,是一座高大,强制的房屋,其众多的塔楼使它看起来像一座要塞.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The hotel was a modern glass and metal building, ten storeys high.
entries.zh: 酒店是一座现代玻璃和金属建筑,高十层.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The modern, semi-detached house was in a quiet cul-de-sac and shielded from the road by a line of pine trees.
entries.zh: 这栋现代双拼住宅坐落在一条安静的尽头路上，一排松树将它与道路隔开。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They had rented an impressive single-storey villa. Its front was painted peach and the windows were framed by carved white shutters.
entries.zh: 他们租了一座令人印象深刻的单层别墅,前身是桃色,窗户是雕刻的白色百叶窗框.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a charming, inviting home with an arched wooden porch covered in honeysuckle and flanked by a sweetly scented herb garden.
entries.zh: 它是一个迷人的,邀请回家 带有一个拱形的木质门廊 覆盖在蜂蜜带上 侧面有一个甜味的草园。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The house was falling down. It was a pile of stones, shattered walls and empty, gaping window frames.
entries.zh: 房子倒塌了,是一堆石头,墙壁破碎,窗框空旷。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The place felt evil. It was the type of place that made people quicken their step as they passed.
entries.zh: 这个地方感觉很邪恶,正是这种地方使人们在经过时加快脚步。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Ivy clasped the walls of the house and curled through the roof.
entries.zh: 艾薇将房子的墙壁盖住,并卷过屋顶.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a rickety old cottage with dark green moss spreading across the walls like mould on bread.
entries.zh: 它是一个坚硬的老式小屋,里面有深绿色的苔藓,像面包上的模具一样在墙壁上扩散.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The house was nearly derelict. Its stonework was decayed and crumbling, its windows boarded up, paint peeling and sills rotting.
entries.zh: 房子几乎被毁坏,其石工腐烂和坍塌,窗户上挂,油漆剥皮和淤泥腐烂。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a huge, dirty, ramshackle place, with broken windows and a roof that leaked like a colander.
entries.zh: 这是一个巨大的,肮脏的,斜坡的地方, 有破碎的窗户和一个屋顶 漏得像山丘。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Only ragged traces of glass remained in the windows – sharp spears jutting out of rotting sills.
entries.zh: 窗户上只有玻璃的痕迹 尖锐的长矛从腐烂的树枝上喷出

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The derelict building stood lifeless. Its crumbling chimneys and hanging gutters were clogged with rotting leaves and the walls were pitted, as if they had been gnawed by hundreds of starving rats.
entries.zh: 废弃的建筑没有生命力,其倒塌的烟囱和悬浮的沟槽被腐烂的叶子堵住,墙壁被坑,仿佛被数百只饥饿的老鼠咬住。
